name: OS Basics
text: An operating system manages hardware and lets programs run. It handles memory, files, devices, and CPU access.

name: Processes
text: A process is a program in execution. It moves through states: new, ready, running, waiting, terminated.

name: Threads
text: A thread is the smallest unit of execution inside a process. Multiple threads share memory but run independently.

name: CPU Scheduling
text: CPU scheduling decides which process runs next. Round Robin gives each process a fixed time slice before switching.

name: Deadlocks
text: A deadlock happens when processes wait on each other for resources in a circular chain, so none can proceed.
